LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Enlist_Button_Desc: Take a posting within the Institute. Pay is generous, the work is exacting, and nobody above you explains themselves twice.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Sat: The Institute doesn't recruit strangers. Build more standing with them first.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Factio: {0} won't enlist with a faction your colony is at war with.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Missions_Desc: Accept tasking assignments from the Directorate and collect payment once they're closed out.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Salary_Desc: A regular payment for services rendered, deducted from a budget nobody outside the Directorate has ever seen in full.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Storage_Desc: Store and withdraw goods from the Institute's own stockpiles.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_AdvancedSystems_Desc: Assist with reactor and synth-chassis research. Builds Intellectual and Crafting skill over time.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_SRBTraining_Desc: Drill under Synth Retention Bureau instructors. Builds Shooting and Melee skill over time.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Containment_Desc: Tend to caravan members with Institute-grade medicine and a noticeably higher standard of care.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Turn_In_Desc: Hand over a captured prisoner to the Institute for a price, no questions asked about where they came from.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Resign_Menu_Text: Resigning ends your standing with the Institute immediately. Are you sure?
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Resign_Button_Desc: End your standing with the Institute. They won't ask you to reconsider.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call in Institute personnel to assist against a nearby threat, at a cost to your standing.
